Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model.game

Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.game.GameEngine
public class GameEngine extends Object
Core game engine managing game state and move validation. This class is responsible for managing the game logic, including setting up the game, validating and executing player moves, managing eliminations, and detecting game over conditions. It maintains the deck, table, and game state throughout the entire game.

    • GameEngine

      public GameEngine(List<Player> players)
      Constructs a GameEngine with the specified players. Initializes the game with a new deck, table, and game state.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players in the game
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the players list is null or empty

  • Method Details

    • setupGame

      public void setupGame() throws InvalidMoveException
      Sets up the initial game state by dealing cards to all players. Each player receives 4 cards, and a fifth card is placed on the table to start the game.
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if the initial card exceeds the sum limit

    • playHumanCard

      public void playHumanCard(HumanPlayer player, Card card) throws InvalidMoveException, GameOverException
      Executes a move by a human player. Validates that the card is in the player's hand and is playable, then places it on the table and removes it from the player's hand.
      Parameters:
      player - the human player making the move
      card - the card to play
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if the card is not in the player's hand or exceeds the limit
      GameOverException - if the move causes the game to end

    • playMachineTurn

      public void playMachineTurn(MachinePlayer machine) throws InvalidMoveException, GameOverException
      Executes a move by a computer-controlled player. The machine player automatically selects a card using its strategy and plays it.
      Parameters:
      machine - the machine player making the move
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if the player has no valid cards to play
      GameOverException - if the move causes the game to end

    • eliminateCurrentPlayer

      public boolean eliminateCurrentPlayer() throws GameOverException
      Eliminates the current player if they cannot play. If the player cannot play any valid cards, they are eliminated and their hand is added back to the deck. Checks if the game is over after elimination.
      Returns:
      true if the player was eliminated, false if they can still play
      Throws:
      GameOverException - if only one player remains after elimination

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard(Player player)
      Gives a card to the specified player from the deck. This is typically used when a player needs to draw a card during gameplay.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to receive a card

    • advanceTurn

      public void advanceTurn()
      Advances the turn to the next player. This method is called at the end of each player's turn to move to the next active player.
